profile.name: Asif Shahriar Tauhid
profile.about_me:
I am a Computer Science student and aspiring Full-Stack Developer with a strong passion for building scalable, user-focused applications. My primary focus is modern web development, where I work with JavaScript, React, Node.js, Express.js, MongoDB, and PostgreSQL while continuously expanding my knowledge of backend systems and software architecture.

Beyond learning new technologies, I enjoy understanding how systems work under the hood, solving complex problems, and developing projects from the ground up. I regularly strengthen my programming fundamentals through data structures and algorithms, version control with Git, and hands-on development.

My long-term goal is to become a skilled software engineer who builds reliable, efficient, and impactful software, contributes to open-source projects, and continuously learns emerging technologies.

projects.title: RentNest
projects.description:
🏡 RentNest — Modern Property Rental Platform.

RentNest is a comprehensive, state-of-the-art frontend application designed to power a modern property rental platform. Built with the Next.js App Router, React 19, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS v4, it offers tailored experiences for different user roles (Admin, Landlord, Tenant) through highly interactive and responsive dashboards.

projects.title: PulseCity
projects.description:
PulseCity Event Explorer is a React + Vite web app for discovering events, viewing details, and creating local booking records after login.

Features
-Firebase authentication (email/password + Google OAuth)
-Protected routes for event details, profile, and dashboard
-Event listing from public/events.json (upcoming + trending sections)
-Event details page with local reservation form
-User profile update for display name and photo URL
-Dark-themed UI with Tailwind CSS v4, DaisyUI, AOS, Swiper, and Gooey --Toast

projects.title: LifeOS
projects.description: Life OS is a premium, offline-first productivity platform that replaces the chaos of juggling multiple apps with one calm, editorial-grade dashboard. It integrates tasks, habits, journaling, goals, and deep-focus tools into a single intentional system.

experience.description: Collaborated with a team of students to design and develop the official club flagship event landing page.

Built multiple full-stack and frontend applications utilizing modern tools like React, Tailwind CSS, and Firebase.
Consistently solved algorithmic problems and pushed code to GitHub to maintain an active learning streak.
Mastered modern developer workflows including version control, responsive design, and local storage state management.

blogs.title: A Little About Me
blogs.content:
Hey! I'm Asif.

I'm a Computer Science student with a simple goal: to become someone who can build software that genuinely helps people.

My journey into programming started with learning the basics of C. Since then, I've explored Java, JavaScript, and modern web development. Every new concept reminds me how much there is still to learn, and that's exactly what keeps me motivated.

These days, most of my time is spent studying, coding, and working on personal projects. I enjoy the process of taking an idea, breaking it into smaller problems, and slowly turning it into something that actually works. There's something incredibly satisfying about seeing a project come together after hours of debugging and learning.

I'm particularly interested in full-stack development, but I'm also curious about software architecture, databases, open-source software, and the technologies that power modern applications behind the scenes. I believe understanding the fundamentals is just as important as learning the latest frameworks.

Outside of programming, I'm someone who enjoys learning in general. Whether it's watching technical talks, reading documentation, or exploring a new tool, I like expanding my knowledge one step at a time. I don't expect to know everything overnight—I just aim to be a little better than I was yesterday.

Looking ahead, I hope to grow into a software engineer who builds reliable, scalable, and meaningful applications. Along the way, I want to keep challenging myself, contribute to open-source projects, and never stop learning.

If you're also on a journey of learning, building, or simply figuring things out, welcome. I hope we can learn something from each other.

Thanks for being here.
